description: Defines a master record for a combat encounter, tracking participants, state, and turn order.

actorRef.description: A strong reference to the participant's actor record (character.profile or npc).

team.description: An identifier for the team the participant belongs to (e.g., 'players', 'enemies').

initiative.description: The participant's initiative roll, used to determine turn order.

locationRef.description: A strong reference to the location where the combat is taking place.

status.description: The current state of the combat encounter.

round.description: The current round number of the combat.

turnHolderRef.description: A strong reference to the participant whose turn it currently is.

outcome.description: The final outcome of the combat, set when the status becomes 'completed'.
